notes:
Adds dedicated PVR_COM and PVR_OXAX playback modes for playlist entries.

Playlist playback now resolves the current stream and returns it to PVR IPTV Simple through Kodi's resolved-URL mechanism instead of starting the player directly.

Generated playlist links now use channel= instead of name= to avoid collisions with stale or duplicated name parameters.

Adds compatibility handling for older cached links that contain multiple name parameters by selecting the last valid value instead of failing with a Python list type error.

Normal playback from the Custom Site, Settings, playlist creation/update, thumbnails, Landscape Wall support and self-update behavior remain unchanged from v1.86.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
